newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin moved to hospital on doctor's orders.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin moved to hospital on doctor's orders.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who had heart surgery only two months ago, was taken to hospital on Wednesday after doctors detected early signs of pneumonia, the Kremlin said.

A Kremlin spokesman said the 65-year-old president, who had cancelled all official meetings since Monday after going down with a heavy cold, had been moved to the Central Clinical Hospital in Moscow on doctor's orders.
Asked if Yeltsin had already been taken to hospital, a Kremlin spokesman said: "Yes."

Kremlin officials and Yeltsin's doctors have said repeatedly that his latest illness is not connected with the quintuple heart operation which the president had on November 5 and that there is no cause for alarm.
